# @bloxwap/sfx

> Interface sound effects for the web, synthesized with Web Audio. 19 sounds, no audio files, zero runtime dependencies. Each sound renders once to a buffer; every play is one AudioBufferSourceNode.

Install: `npm install @bloxwap/sfx`

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/): what the library is and how it works
- [Quick start](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/getting-started/): install, bind(), play()
- [Sound catalog](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/sounds/): all 19 sounds and when to use them
- [Declarative binding](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/guides/binding/): data-sound-hover, -press, -release, -toggle
- [React](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/guides/react/)
- [Other frameworks](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/guides/frameworks/): Vue, Svelte, Astro, plain HTML
- [Sound design](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/guides/sound-design/): which sound for which moment
- [Accessibility and preferences](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/guides/accessibility/)
- [API reference](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/api/)
- [Recipes](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/api/recipes/): the sound data format
- [Performance](https://bloxwap.github.io/sfx/docs/performance/)
